title: 买关注控信息已过时：数据科学改变营销本质，品牌还能实时回应消费者吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Marketing used to be simple. You made a product, you bought attention, and you controlled the message.
segments.zh: 营销曾经很简单。你做出产品，购买关注，掌控信息。

segments.en: That world is over. Data sciences, behavioral economics, and technologies like artificial intelligence
segments.zh: 那个时代已经结束。数据科学、行为经济学以及人工智能等技术

segments.en: are all changing the very nature of marketing. Now brands need to respond to consumers in real time.
segments.zh: 都在改变营销的本质。现在品牌需要实时回应消费者。

segments.en: Brand building is both about moving at the speed of culture and at the pace of technology.
segments.zh: 品牌建设既要跟上文化速度，也要跟上技术步伐。

segments.en: Because every moment is an opportunity. I'm Rajah Rajabannan, lifelong student of marketing and best selling author.
segments.zh: 因为每个时刻都是机会。我是Raja Rajamannar，终身营销学习者和畅销书作者。

segments.en: I'm going inside this company to explore the systems, the people, and the insights driving this transformation.
segments.zh: 我将深入这家公司，探索推动这一变革的系统、人员和洞察。

segments.en: So we have a dashboard that kind of shows the virality of our products.
segments.zh: 我们有一个仪表板，可以显示产品的传播热度。

segments.en: You can see that it goes to a particular rural town or an apartment complex.
segments.zh: 你可以看到它具体到某个乡村小镇或公寓小区。

segments.en: When you think about everything that Airbnb has to offer, people are really looking for human experiences over luxury.
segments.zh: 当你想到Airbnb提供的一切，人们真正追求的是人性化体验，而非奢华。
